title: Polymorphism & constraints
hints: README 'New syntax': the constraint (`Ord a =>`, `Eq a =>` …) tells you which operations you may use; the Prelude has maximum, product, min, max and elem.

largest: Nothing for [], else Just the maximum. countOf: keep the elements equal to x, count them. joinShown: show each, join with ", ". sumAndProduct: a pair of sum and product. clamp: not below lo, not above hi. dedupe: walk the list remembering what you've seen; skip the seen ones.
Other data: `length (filter (> 2) [1, 5, 3])` → 2 · `intercalate "|" (map show [True, False])` · `runningMax` in the README shows a `go` helper carrying state.
`clamp lo hi x = max lo (min hi x)` · `dedupe = go [] where go _ [] = []; go seen (x : rest) | elem x seen = go seen rest | otherwise = x : go (x : seen) rest`.
